title: namedargs2cell
summary: Convert a scalar name-value struct into an alternating name/value cell row.
description: `namedargs2cell(S)` preserves scalar struct field order and returns `{name1, value1, name2, value2, ...}` for name-value forwarding patterns.
behaviors: Returns a normal value and does not mutate inputs.
Accepts MATLAB text/struct representations supported by RunMat.
